notes.title: 📢 Hotfix 0.5.2 is live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🧟‍♂️ Cursed Deal – Hotfix Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

First of all, we want to thank everyone who discovered us during the Zombies vs Vampires Steam Event. Your support and feedback have helped us improve the game in meaningful ways. We’re incredibly grateful to have such a passionate community backing us. ❤️

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]⚙️ Game System Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] You can now earn XP and level up in Solo Mode. This has been a long-requested feature from solo players and is finally here!
[/list]

[h2][b]🎮 Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] The sprint mechanic for gamepads has been reworked: sprinting now uses a toggle method instead of hold.
[*] Human jump height increased by 16%, giving you slightly more vertical mobility.
[/list]

[h2][b] 🧠 Skill Changes: [/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] The Eye of the Crow skill can now be manually exited at any time.
[*] At the end of Eye of the Crow, you will now return to your crow’s last position, not your original location.
[/list]

[h2][b] 🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where the game would close Discord or other background applications unexpectedly.
[*] Fixed a bug where entering the menu during "waiting for players" or while transforming into the creature caused players to become stuck and unable to return to the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Push-to-Talk voice setting would automatically switch back to “Always On” after the match ends.
[/list]

[h2][b]🖥️ UI Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] 60 FPS cap added to the main menu to improve performance and reduce unnecessary GPU usage.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t exit the keybinding screen.
[*] Removed the menu shake animation to improve clarity and visual comfort.
[*] We've added a microphone icon for players using Push-to-Talk while in the menu.
[*] Fixed text overflow in the “No Game Result” screen.
[*] Fixed font size issues in the “Only Leader Can Search Game” popup button.
[/list]

[h2][b]🗺️ Map/Environment Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] Invisible walls and barriers have been removed from the playable area and replaced with fences. However, [b]in rare cases, you might still encounter invisible boundaries to prevent players from getting stuck in unwanted spots when using Bat or Crow transformation abilities.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/fac613892b94a57a372ec538a984568c08f403bc.jpg[/img]

[*] Based on how streamers and players navigated the map, we observed common movement paths. To address visual inconsistencies caused by players running between trees and rocks, we’ve added new side paths to guide movement more naturally. 

[*] A wooden bridge has been added to the forest area to better blend with the environment and improve navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/471c37168d36280d22f2ae5c0e34e6e0c8a122e2.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2][b]🔍 Known Issues – Under Investigation:[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] The mini-game UI sometimes does not disappear and remains on screen until the match ends. We are still investigating this issue.
[*] Gamepad sensitivity settings appear to be working during our internal tests, but we’re monitoring reports for edge cases.
[*] Creature crouch mode setting not saving – currently working as intended in our testing, but we’re continuing to monitor.
[*] Although it’s not very frequent, some players may occasionally experience random connection timeout issues.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Thank you to our community for reporting issues and helping the game grow. Cursed Deal is continuously improving and becoming more polished with every update. If you encounter any problems, don’t hesitate to let us know. We’re actively monitoring reports through Discord and Steam Discussions. Thank you so much, see you in the next update!

[hr][/hr]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/703680/Cursed_Deal/

notes.title: Gameplay Guide
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]
[b]Note:[/b] GIFs and videos appear darker due to compression. You can refer to the images on the Steam homepage for the game's in-game lighting.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Cursed Deal was designed to be completely co-op focused[/b], but we see that solo players are showing a lot of interest in the demo. We have created a new roadmap considering both solo and co-op players. We will share it with you soon. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/gwsjk69jW7]Discord[/url] for real-time updates.


[hr][/hr]


[h2][b]Cultist Player:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] The task of the vampire cult is to collect the ritual items needed for the ritual and to perform it while fending off the creature. The number of ritual items is determined based on the number of players.

[*] You can use the rune stone to find the altar where the ritual item is located. After using the rune stone, you can hold down Q to see where the altar is located.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/f09985d423c776b6c001bd18ea0220f1754bd99a.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] If you decide to check any altar you come across and it is empty, your location will be revealed to the player who is the creature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/8e034c3a6f2e2dd872030d0b8d1263ab44a26f54.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] To repel the creature, you need to flash your flashlight within the [b]green[/b] and [b]orange[/b] range. If it’s in the red, meaning overcharged, it won’t work. In the overcharged state, the creature will not be affected by the flash. We’ve noticed that some players do not fully understand the flashing mechanic during the tutorial; in the tutorial, you are asked to flash the creature. You need to hold down LMB (Left Mouse Button) and release it at the appropriate time. We’ve added this mechanic to balance the gameplay between the creature and the human players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/cf78c16dc27c13d2540064cad631789c2eeee30d.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] When you enter an altar, you will see 2 or 3 red trails that you need to follow. Only one of these trails is correct and will lead you to the ritual item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/340d76bb5f27dc3731fd0197085d87264c169a33.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/4fece7362e3ff0c707434419faa9060bd98774f1.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] If you get lost, you can use the middle mouse button to place a pin, indicating your location to your teammates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/1adb5d299e6b3e840a6e3eeca5c25d97a52cb987.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]Creature Player:[/b][/h2]

[*] By breaking rune stones, you can briefly see the players' locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/4f80f60e9fdd79d97b1fc6c3c6c60f746cc958ab.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] You can add a skill to the creature that allows you to see the location of the humans. Make sure to distribute the abilities equally between the cultist and the creature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/060d253f3d51c599c9b8d1005ca3eb3096dee354.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[*] Anti-camping mechanic. If a human player remains inactive for 2 minutes, their location will be revealed to the creature player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563662/50653bbc33ff4fdbc7dd4ed52a97ed8571c7d9c5.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
We are grateful for the interest you've shown in the demo. In today's update, we’ve made some translation adjustments and added a few tweaks to make the game and action a bit more dynamic, such as letting the creature see your location when using an empty altar.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We discovered that for some players in the tutorial, the boss wasn't spawning after the ritual sequence. We apologize for the bad experience but are happy to say this issue has been fixed.
[*] We found and fixed a bug during the interaction with the first altar in the tutorial, where the game would get stuck and stop progressing.
[*] The issue with sound settings not being saved has been resolved.
[*] The issue where the creature wouldn't spawn in the tutorial has been fixed.
[*] Measures have been taken to stop the AI creature from getting stuck on objects and spawning in the nest with you.
[*] We’ve prevented the ai creature from following you while interacting with the altar.
[/list]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've added an extra explanation in the tutorial on how to flash the creature. 
[*] For those who couldn't find the creature in the tutorial, we've added two separate explanations after completing the ritual and becoming a vampire. You can now use the bat transformation ability and rune stones to instantly reveal the creature's location. 
[/list]

[b]Edited:[/b]
[list]
[*] The abandoned temple area has been tweaked to fit better within the tutorial.
[*] The first flying spirit in the tutorial is now designed as a jumpscare (it moves much faster), but you can flash it while it’s attacking to neutralize it. For the other flying spirit, simply aim your flashlight at it to make it disappear.
[/list]

[b]Your feedback is incredibly important to us. Please don't hesitate to join our Discord group to share suggestions or report any issues you encounter.[/b]


[b]Please don't forget to add your wishlist:[/b]

notes.title: Demo Announcement
notes.notes:
We are [b]READY![/b]

The demo will be released on [b]September 24th - 1:00 AM GMT+3[/b]. We're excited to see the test results and whether you're interested in the game.

During the demo period, we will give the game for free to the top [b]100[/b] people who have collected the highest scores ([b]XP points[/b]) when the game is released. (It's only for co-op players, except solo mode and tutorial mission)

[b]It's worth reminding:[/b]
[list]
[*] Make sure you distribute the ability points you'll get specifically for the demo equally and carefully for both creature and human players!
[*] There is a setting in the game and language settings section for the creature player where you can turn off the creature screen effect. In some of our tests, we received feedback that the red creature effect was different but challenging for players. So, remember that you can only turn off that setting in the menu.
[*] The game has a 3D voice communication feature based on distance. If you find a walkie-talkie in the game (and if your friend also has a walkie-talkie), you can communicate with your distant team member. The game uses your Windows default audio input and output device as the default audio device.
[*] If you encounter any problems, you can report the issue through our Discord group.
[/list]

[b]Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist if you play the demo and like it.[/b]
